name: Jezebels Curse
source:
John is a young man living in Japan, until one day his beautiful sister Lily comes to visit him. Little does he know is not just a random visit...

Lily's goal all along was to find and defeat an evil entity residing in the same area John stays. Her powers? Telekinesis from mana (sexual energy).

Will Lily reach her goal, or will she fall?

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/jzbcurse/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
約翰是個生活在日本的年輕人。一天，他美麗的姊妹莉莉前來探望，他並不知道，她可不是碰巧順路……

莉莉此行真正的目的，是找到盤踞在約翰住處附近的邪惡存在，並將其擊敗。她的本領？靠魔力，也就是性能量，隔空操縱物體。

莉莉能否達成目的？還是會先敗下陣來？
